editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Saxo Bank scores 8.4 out of 10 from NAFT in May 2026. A genuinely institutional-grade platform with a full Danish banking licence, FCA and MAS regulation, and 71,000+ instruments. The $50 million AML fine in January 2026 is a material governance concern but relates to white-label partner oversight — not retail client funds. Withdrawals are clean, platforms are best-in-class, and depositor protection exists. But Classic tier spreads are wider than specialist forex brokers, and the lack of MetaTrader means no EA compatibility. A legitimate premium broker with a recent compliance blemish that sophisticated traders should acknowledge but not overweight.
